rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that feels agreeable or comfortable, such as a pleasant walk or atmosphere.

example.english: This seaside path is very pleasant to walk along.
example.traditional: 呢條海邊小路行落好舒服。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 hoi2 bin1 siu2 lou6 haang4 lok6 hou2 syu1 fuk6

rows.note: Use this when the pleasant experience mainly makes someone feel happy or cheerful.

example.english: Having dinner with my classmates is really pleasant.
example.traditional: 同班朋友食飯真係好開心。
example.jyutping: tung4 baan1 pang4 jau5 sik6 faan6 zan1 hai6 hou2 hoi1 sam1

rows.note: Use this for a more polished description of an enjoyable experience, interaction, or manner.

example.english: I wish you a pleasant journey.
example.traditional: 祝你有一個愉快嘅旅程。
example.jyutping: zuk1 nei5 jau5 jat1 go3 jyu4 faai3 ge3 leoi5 cing4

rows.note: Use this broad everyday choice when pleasant simply means nice or good in context.

example.english: The weather is pleasant today, so it’s perfect for a hike.
example.traditional: 今日天氣好，最啱去郊遊。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 hou2 zeoi3 ngaam1 heoi3 gaau1 jau4
